products.name: Weck Tulip Jars 1 Liter, 2 with Glass Lids

variant.status: Manufacturer confirms individual model and capacity. Two-pack is supported by indexed third-party product links only. Manufacturer US page sells a different six-pack.

sources.evidence: ParseShelf labels this ASIN #57 in its US Cookware snapshot. Independently published rank, not independently audited Amazon data or unit sales.
Manufacturer identifies model 745 as 1 L Tulip Jar. Manufacturer package is six, so it does not validate the Amazon two-pack.
Indexed retailer exposes B08CFWDQX1, model 745, 1L and two jars with glass lids. Historical identity support, not a current Amazon offer.
Specialist baking source lists 1 LT #745 in its jar selection. Audience/use-case support only, not product-level sales.

products.audience_fit: Home bakers choosing a reusable jar for starter maintenance or pantry storage. A measured spoon-access and shelf-fit demonstration would answer practical purchase questions.
products.objections: Tulip shoulders complicate judging volume growth compared with straight-sided jars. Check shelf height, cleaning access, glass breakage risk and the actual supplied lids, rings and clips. Owning a suitable jar may remove the need to buy.
products.angle: Three-minute original production plan, 'Does a 1-liter tulip jar fit your baking routine?' 0:00–0:20 show the jar-access problem and spoken affiliate disclosure. 0:20–0:50 identify the actual model and supplied pieces after procurement or owner-provided footage, without claiming a hands-on test now. 0:50–1:25 use measured room-temperature water to demonstrate usable headroom and show that tulip shape is not a linear volume gauge. 1:25–2:00 compare spoon access and cleanup with an already-owned straight-sided jar. 2:00–2:35 measure shelf fit and discuss breakage and unnecessary extra purchases. 2:35–3:00 identify suitable buyers and link to the reviewed KFF guide. No canning instructions or freshness claims. Original footage only, music with documented commercial rights, price-free. Production remains pending exact product and asset verification.
